args_named.title: Method Study 001C: anatomy of the 2,226 post-filter disagreements with NESO skip methodology (retrospective, corpus 2026-08-04..10)

args_named.statement: The majority of the 2,226 cells flagged by the feasibility-aware screen but not skipped at NESO stage 5 are attributable to NESO-published exclusion categories or to full acceptance of the in-merit volume, leaving a minority unmatched by public operational explanations.

args_named.conclusion: CONFIRMED, far beyond the majority threshold: of the 2,226 post-filter disagreement cells, 99.7 percent carry a public operational explanation - 40.3 percent absent from NESO's in-merit availability universe, 34.5 percent behind constraint, 23.1 percent other published exclusion categories or full acceptance - leaving 6 cells (0.27 percent, all bid-side battery/small units) unmatched. Layered agreement with NESO stage 5 on the fixed 6,390-cell universe: 34.9 percent naive, 64.7 percent with physical deliverability, 66.6 percent peak adding wind-offer exclusions; binary adoption of volumetric exclusion categories beyond that degrades agreement (constraint layer forfeits 970 genuine catches), so further progress requires volume-level reconstruction.
